attributes.text: Tap, Tap is free and open source
attributes.originalText: Tap, Tap is free and open source

attributes.text: Tap, Tap is and always will be free, building off open source components. The source code is available for anyone to view and make edits to at the GitHub repository. Official free downloads for the app are only available at XDA, the GitHub repository, and APKMirror. The official app will always automatically offer to download updates from GitHub, if you have allowed internet access.

attributes.text: Only install Tap, Tap from one of the official sources linked above. If you downloaded from any other source, it is highly recommended you uninstall it and reinstall from one of the links above. Tap for more info.

attributes.text: If you like the Tap, Tap app and wish to make a donation, the link to do so is near the bottom of the "More" page after setup. Regardless of whether you donate, your sharing and support and use of Tap, Tap is much appreciated, thank you!
